entries.name: 慌张
entries.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: transparent desktop-pet expression sticker PNG.
Input image: edit target, a screenshot of sticker cards.
Primary request: Extract ONLY the LEFT sticker, spiral pink/blue eyes, yellow crown, sleep mask above her head (Chinese card caption "慌张"). Remove the beige card, its border, outside game UI, and all caption text. Keep the exact original character pose, face, hair, accessories, pillow/phone if present, outlines, colours and small floating effects unchanged. This is a faithful cutout, not a redesign. Preserve all light and white regions inside the character and props as opaque.
Composition: one complete isolated sticker, centred, tight framing with a small transparent margin on every side; no clipping of hair, accessories or effects. No other sticker.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. No card, no text, no new shadow, no checkerboard painted into the image.
